questions.question: Mahindra and Mahindra car company is claiming that their average sales for this quarter are 1500 cars, with SD 2. A sample study is taken from Karnataka and it was found that average sales from 90 showrooms was 1494. Is their claim valid? / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Stating the hypotheses (at least null hypothesis) H0: μ = 1500 against H1: μ ≠ 1500
  • - 2 marks Test statistic under H0, Z = (𝑋 − 𝜇0) 𝜎 √𝑛 = (1494 − 1500) 2 √90 = -28.4605
  • - 2 marks Conclusion: Critical region |Z| > 1.96 and hence reject H0 - 2 marks

questions.question: A university administrator wants to know if a student's class rank is independent of whether they live on campus or off-campus. A random sample of 250 students provided the following data: Examine it using chi square test for independence. Living Status Upper rank Lower rank On Campus 90 45 Off Campus 30 85 / [CO3] [12x1 = 12]
questions.solution_html:
• Calculation of the test statistic under H0, 𝜒2 = ∑𝑖 {(𝑂𝑖 − 𝐸𝑖)2𝐸𝑖 } = 40.9699
  • - 5 marks
  • where expected frequencies are 64.8, 70.2, 55.2, 59.8 – 1 mark each
  • OR
  • Calculation of the test statistic under H0, 𝜒2 = ∑𝑖 {(𝑂𝑖 − 𝐸𝑖)2𝐸𝑖 } = 40.32426
  • - 5 marks
  • where expected frequencies are 65, 70, 55, 60 – 1 mark each
  • Degrees of freedom = (r-1) (c-1) = 1 - 1 mark
  • Conclusion: Critical region 𝜒2 > 3.841 and hence reject H0 - 2
  • marks [A][3] (1x12=12 marks)
